verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's docs describe a dedicated hybrid search capability that combines full-text keyword matching with semantic search, backed by automatic embedding generation once an embedder is configured. A product page reinforces the 'keyword precision with AI that understands meaning' positioning. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that both strategies are fused in a single query request, details of the fusion/weighting controls (e.g. a semantic ratio), and independent hands-on corroboration that hybrid ranking works as described.
